t: 荷兰政治家约翰·范奥尔登巴内韦尔特被定为叛国罪后被处决于海牙.
te: Dutch statesman Johan van Oldenbarnevelt is executed in The Hague after being convicted of treason.
dz: 荷兰政治家约翰·范奥尔登巴内韦尔特被定为叛国罪后被处决于海牙.
de: Dutch statesman Johan van Oldenbarnevelt is executed in The Hague after being convicted of treason.

dz: 三十年战争：扎布拉蒂之战，波西米亚起义的转折点。
de: Thirty Years' War: Battle of Záblatí, a turning point in the Bohemian Revolt.
